	likelihood_idx = header.index(extraction_metadata[3]["Value"])

	df1["ib_service_name"] = "TBD"
	df1["affected_package_name"] = df1["Title"]
	df1["fixed_version"] = df1["Solution"].map(lambda x: re.findall(r"SOLUTION:(.*)", x[-50:])).map(lambda x: x[0] if x else '')
	
	df = []
	for idx, row in df1.iterrows():

	        df.append([cve, row["severity"], row["release_version"], row["ib_service_name"], row["affected_package_name"], row["fixed_version"]])
	df = pandas.DataFrame(df, columns = columns)
	
	res = df.to_dict('records')
	
	extraction_id = extraction_metadata[-1]["Value"] + ".csv" # BNYM_yyyy_mm_dd_hh:mm:ss_fname.xlsx
	dfbuffer = io.BytesIO()
	df.to_csv(dfbuffer, index = False)

	with pandas.ExcelWriter(dfbuffer) as writer:
	    df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name = "Sheet1", index = False)'''
	resp = requests.put(
	    f"{url_results_dir}/{extraction_id}",
	    headers = headers,
	    data = dfbuffer.getvalue()
	)
	
	return res
